title: Datewise tokenizer rewrite
content: Decision: Datewise, the open-source date parsing library, drops its regex matcher for a hand-written tokenizer in Rust. The tokenizer is part of the core crate and every new format is covered by cargo-fuzz.

title: Pantry Planner offline storage
content: Pantry Planner keeps recipes in SQLite on the phone and syncs them through Supabase when online. The shopping list feature depends on the unit converter to merge quantities.

title: Soil Probe firmware sampling loop
content: Soil Probe firmware reads the capacitive moisture sensor over I2C every ten minutes and buffers samples in a ring buffer. A low battery reading blocks the nightly OTA update.

title: Quillpress template engine switch
content: Quillpress, a static site generator, moves its templates from Handlebars to Tera. Markdown parsing stays on pulldown-cmark, and preview builds still deploy to Cloudflare Pages.

title: Rookery search improvements
content: Rookery, the hobby chess engine, now searches with negamax and a transposition table keyed by Zobrist hashing. The opening book ships inside the engine binary, and GUIs talk to it over UCI.

title: Linkweaver backlink indexing correction
content: Correction from the maintainer: Linkweaver, the backlink plugin for Joplin, must update its backlink index incrementally. A full rescan on every save blocks typing in large notebooks.

title: Flashdeck scheduler ownership
content: Flashdeck, a spaced repetition trainer, swaps its Leitner boxes for the SM-2 algorithm. The scheduler module now uses SM-2, and the mobile team owns the sync engine.

title: Nightsift session wrap-up
content: Session summary: Nightsift, the astrophotography stacking tool, now aligns exposures with OpenCV feature matching and writes FITS output. Dark frame subtraction is part of the pipeline and depends on the calibration library.

title: Tabtamer sync token storage
content: Security: Tabtamer, a tab-grouping browser extension, kept its sync token in localStorage. It now stores the token in storage.session instead, and the content script can no longer read it.

title: Gridsmith solver port
content: Gridsmith, a crossword generator, is being ported from Python to Rust. The fill solver depends on a trie built from the word list, and the Python prototype stays only for comparison runs.
